convention: WMS1.1.1 GetFeatureInfo EPSG4326;3x3 pixels centred on location, bbox lon+-0.000008,lat+-0.000006,X1,Y1. Two concurrent cached requests. Full URLs and raw query cache retained inTemp.

foundation.source: ICGC DTM0.5m2021-2023,EGM08D595 ASL. SourceRTT1271519 boundary sections every<=12m; source vertices shorter than1.5m omitted from station placement. Samples on the edge and3/6m outside physical footprint, excluding other roofed RTT buildings. Edge cells are diagnostic, not foundation authority;6m downhill minima are not automatically adopted.

roofGrid.source: ICGC DSM1m2021-2023, EGM08D595 ASL;5m-spaced study samples inside sourceRTT1271519, holes excluded. This is evidence for classifying/fitting architectural roof planes, not an automatic raster-extruded model. Exact WGS84 positions registered throughEPSG25831.

transverseProfiles.source: ICGC DSM1m and DTM0.5m 2021-2023, EGM08D595 metres ASL
transverseProfiles.method: Point positions registered through exact orthophoto EPSG:25831 extent -> WGS84 -> WMS GetFeatureInfo, 3x3 window centred on requested coordinate. 0.325m/pixel ortho. No ENU/UTM offset mixing. Two concurrent requests, persistent cache; no OSM call.
transverseProfiles.warning: Sparse study sections, not construction survey. Raster roof edges/cell mixtures, vegetation, solar panels and optical displacement may affect values. DTM under a building is interpolation, not its occupied floor or foundation. Exterior identities must be checked against primary drawings/photos.
